records.title: All internal practice except counseling/parent communication
records.text: Include class preparation, lesson work, progress, homework, wrong answers, assessment, attendance and internal journals. Exclude counseling and parent-facing communication actions. Historical source custody is preserved.

records.title: Preserve ownership and integrate entrypoint/contracts first
records.text: No repository relocation or student-original custody transfer is selected. Unify discovery and execution-contract references while keeping current policy, code, research and native owners.

records.title: Date then class then student
records.text: Default navigation begins with the dated class/cohort, then student preparation and unfinished work. A weekday pattern or old class candidate does not establish today membership.

records.title: Diagnose and improve broad bottlenecks with scoped IDs
records.text: Preserve per-finding evidence, impacted workflow, owner, Task, action and verification. A local finding ID is not a native Run or domain entity identifier.

records.title: Use the current operational contract route
records.text: dc-gang-a/AGENTS.md selects academy-operational-contract.json and workflow-current-state.json. Older Windows/Main/mobile onboarding remains retained intent/history. This catalog does not rewrite those originals.

records.title: Do not reopen settled web app and storage choices
records.text: The workflow checkpoint records transition A and private PostgreSQL. Earlier future-provider/Main-first pending questions need scope-qualified reconciliation, not a repeated broad storage interview.

records.title: Retain old runtime and priority context
records.text: README/CODEX_CONTEXT/context-map contain dated Windows/Main/mobile routes. They remain original evidence but do not override the currently selected operational contract.

records.title: Resolve by owner, scope and field, not global date
records.text: Keep occurredAt, observedAt, retrievedAt, source version and teacher decision time distinct. A later report may correct class membership without changing book edition or proving completion. Unknown authoritative currentness holds only dependent effects.

records.title: Entire history denominator remains unknown
records.text: All identified entrypoints are indexed; neither selected 64-message/13-block context nor the overlapping monthly dossier establishes whole conversation/Space coverage. Missing originals, inaccessible histories and private payloads remain explicit.

records.title: Use multiple topology types
records.text: Containment and task dependencies require acyclic structure; semantic relations may cycle; original/revision provenance preserves lineage; repeated classroom steps may return to grading/correction. The repository build graph is a separate verification graph.

records.title: Teacher completion is its own evidence state
records.text: Assignment, solving, app entry, grading, correction, teacher review, teacher completion, generated paper, print and distribution are separate. A score or empty LMS field cannot complete the rest.

records.title: Edition hierarchy and source section identity must survive joins
records.text: Keep edition-local exact labels and missing hierarchy levels. Current edition:CODE:vN identifiers and source edition hashes require an explicit candidate crosswalk; code/version similarity alone is not canonical equality.

records.title: Existing integrated code owner is not a new custody transfer
records.text: education-platform/apps/academy/gang-a is the maintained gang-a code path. The retained standalone source, historical context, native bindings and student originals keep their owners.

records.title: Keep internal journal input while excluding parent communication
records.text: Internal attendance, lesson observations, actual progress and future homework remain in scope. The parent-facing projection and transmission portion of DailyRecord is excluded in this Work.

records.title: Assessment chronology is scope-qualified
records.text: General monthly duration, a specific 80-minute research assessment, earlier proposed allocations and later item choices are distinct scopes/revisions. Later choices do not retroactively accept assistant ranking or research validity.

records.title: A catalog is not admitted Memory
records.text: The selector returns source references, relevant current summaries and unresolved findings. Existing agent-platform remains the Work/Memory/Recall algorithm owner; admission/generation/source-lineage/native consumption are separate and not established by this catalog.

records.title: Integrate academy source and organize retained context in private Education
records.text: The user selected education-platform as the integration repository, source/ownership/common-validation/Root-PR completion scope, and broad review of previously approved student/practical context with hierarchy. Three exact student packages and six exact workbench custody groups have separate current destination admissions (566 files total). Root October23 private outputs, native runtime, common algorithm ownership and all effect boundaries remain excluded.

findings.title: Conflicting current and historical onboarding routes
findings.detail: Current contract entry and old README/CODEX_CONTEXT/context-map disagree in runtime/priority framing. New selected context explicitly routes current owners and labels historical sources. Original owner files are preserved.
findings.nextAction: Verify the new entrypoint/selector is actually consumed by the peer; any upstream owner edit requires its own reviewed change.

findings.title: Whole context/history coverage is not established
findings.detail: Selected context and monthly dossier overlap and have unknown total population; private original contents remain at their owners.
findings.nextAction: Maintain source/coverage matrix; use known source keys and exact missing locators, never claim all history recovered.

findings.title: Edition/code/hash and section identifiers differ across sources
findings.detail: Peer independently reports incompatible edition namespace forms and nullable id with present sourceSectionId. This catalog records the reported failure class without reading student payloads or asserting canonical crosswalks.
findings.nextAction: Require sourceSectionId plus edition/source namespace and explicit qualified crosswalk; preserve unmatched records, no naive equality drop.

findings.title: Settled provider choices coexist with retained pending interviews
findings.detail: The checkpoint confirms teacher web app transition A and PostgreSQL while old provider/Main-first questions remain pending. Catalog directs consumers to current decisions and classifies old questions by scope.
findings.nextAction: Use recorded decisions; interview only consequential current gaps and retain original question IDs.

findings.title: Overlapping summaries and originals can be double-counted
findings.detail: Generalized decisions, selected originals, inquiry additions, shared context copies and archives are different evidence classes. Source metadata and selector dedup avoid treating copies as independent authority.
findings.nextAction: Dedup emitted source IDs and preserve original IDs/provenance; do not delete original records to reduce context size.

findings.title: One tree cannot represent every academy relationship
findings.detail: Book containment, task dependencies, semantic relations, revision/provenance and classroom cycles have different rules. New typed catalog validator checks acyclic dimensions separately while preserving valid cycles.
findings.nextAction: Run cycle/dangling tests and keep typed edges in selected packets.

findings.title: Aggregate education check does not cover the whole month-end flow
findings.detail: Root module check and academy route do not include every month-end backend/frontend/research projection dependency. Source presence or one green aggregate check does not verify the full teacher workflow.
findings.nextAction: Consume explicit workflow verification inventory; propose owner-reviewed check routing after qualified package boundaries, not broader completion claims.

findings.title: Canonical curriculum originals remain missing
findings.detail: The retained curriculum export declares five missing canonical inputs and unresolved boundary hash discrepancy.
findings.nextAction: Keep missing inputs/semantic acceptance unresolved; retrieve through owning research Lead before dependent semantic use.

findings.title: Monthly exam decisions can be flattened across revisions
findings.detail: Old allocations and not-selected states are historical; later exact item choices supersede only selected scope, not every earlier uncertainty.
findings.nextAction: Use current month-end entrypoint plus linked chronology, retaining prior original records.

findings.title: Hosted/local/later-private saved sources diverge
findings.detail: Peer observes different saved-date populations in hosted, local and later private sources; actual bodies are excluded here. One successful saved read does not establish current live state.
findings.nextAction: Record source version/observed clock/custody separately and qualify completeness per family before synthesis.

findings.title: Small query caps create repeated calls and silent truncation risk
findings.detail: Peer owns the local250-cap, batched-facets and continuing-cursor candidate; hosted20 cap remains unchanged and native deployment is not performed.
findings.nextAction: Independently review exact candidate code, pagination parity and advertised/runtime schema; preserve explicit continuation and oversize refusal.

findings.title: Repeated overlays and duplicated MCP envelope inflate actual context
findings.detail: Baseline repeated full overlay per query; transport may duplicate a bounded JSON payload as text and structuredContent. Payload byte bound alone does not establish full native result bound.
findings.nextAction: Review actual SDK result envelope with multibyte fixtures; have peer repair owned server/schema code and independently recheck exact successor.

findings.title: Repository proximity can be mistaken for source/data ownership
findings.detail: User selected keeping current owners. Integrated code, operational policy, research semantics, original custody and native execution remain separate even under common checks.
findings.nextAction: Enforce phased repository plan and explicit source refs; no relocation or activation inferred.

findings.title: Same memoryLayers name carries different meaning
findings.detail: Historical authority tiers and memory categories are distinct owner-qualified fields. Catalog does not merge them or create a second Memory admission store.
findings.nextAction: Retain schema/owner/type qualified names and use existing common Memory admission when separately requested.

findings.title: Preparation needs dated class membership before student selection
findings.detail: Default is date/class/student per current user, not an inferred old timetable. Selector is workflow-aware metadata; actual class membership stays qualified private owner input.
findings.nextAction: Peer must use latest exact dated teacher correction for membership and preserve prior candidates as historical.

findings.title: New common source validation is not old consumer adoption
findings.detail: Existing Academy consumer pinffba remains unchanged; current common GitWork reader is used only as a separately identified external audit tool.
findings.nextAction: Record exact external validator commit and preserve old setup/consumer closure; no hidden dependency upgrade.
